I have been a patient of theirs since the age of 3. I am now 31 and every year, the service declines even further.

Over the last year, I’ve had serious health issues including an RTA which has caused prolonged pain and health concerns. As anyone would, I’ve been consulting my GP - who I thought I could trust to help with my concerns/symptoms. Instead, I’ve been told during a recent private appointment organised by my solicitors, that the GP have misdiagnosed me with “health anxiety,” which may influence how future clinicians interpret my physical symptoms.

This GP has also reassured me that they’d refer me to specialists in mid 2025, yet I haven’t even been put on the waiting list. I’m suffering daily with symptoms and pain and it’s being dismissed with things like “health anxiety.”

When I’ve called to book appointments in the past, I’m told I cannot see a doctor and need to speak to a physician/clinician/physiotherapist first. It’s not until I’ve fought for an appointment, they’ve offered a telephone call with a doctor. I am then told that I can’t even see my usual doctor (Dr Mayor), because “there’s no clinics available for him” and instead have been booked in with a completely new doctor who then sat in front of me googling everything and speaking to me in a manner that is deemed highly unprofessional. Following this, her only recommendation for my symptoms was to “get regular massages.” (?!?)

I’ve had countless incidences with this surgery over the years and have unfortunately let it go. I am now at my wits end with what to do and who to go to for help. I don’t think making a complaint to the practice itself would serve a reliable outcome in any way, upon reading previous reviews.

I am truly disheartened by the level of care received by all staff collectively, especially when I’ve needed it the most. It leaves you in an uncertain position of what to do next.
